editions.title: The reference farm
editions.summary: The current farm, data explorer and independent review baseline, preserved as an edition.

changes.title: Preserved gameplay
changes.description: The deployed reference gameplay and prior progress. Edition routing and navigation are compatibility adaptations; no new audio is added to v1.

editions.title: Editions and a quieter farm
editions.summary: Choose independent editions, follow feedback into changes, and optionally add gentle music and sound effects.

changes.title: Independent editions
changes.description: Each edition has its own saved farm, assumptions, branches, conversations and settings.

changes.title: Feedback to evolution
changes.description: Original reviews retain their tested builds. New changes link to evidence without claiming unrelated findings are fixed.

changes.title: Optional gentle audio
changes.description: Original quiet music and soft effects start muted, with separate controls and per-edition preferences.

changes.title: Keyboard voice typing
changes.description: The main message field includes a hint for device-keyboard dictation where available. FarmTact does not record or upload speech.

changes.title: Open feedback: delivery and margin explanations
changes.description: Buyer allocation, policy selection and margin explanations remain areas for improvement. These original reviews are retained; this edition does not claim those gameplay findings are resolved.

editions.title: Seven perspectives, one farm
editions.summary: Seven farming advisors connect demand, weather, market, production, supply chain, profit and planning. Market separates sourced community reactions from demand.

changes.title: Seven advisors with distinct responsibilities
changes.description: Follows Sumin Lee’s seven-role model. Idris becomes Market; Lina joins Supply Chain; Asha concludes the council.

changes.title: Evidence checks without a critic persona
changes.description: Numerical and evidence validation remain automatic. Incomplete or rejected council findings withhold acceptance while computed alternatives remain inspectable.

changes.title: Honest community evidence
changes.description: A provenance-aware, read-only Market panel distinguishes produce reactions from quantities and prices. No social feed is connected yet; missing observations are shown explicitly.

editions.title: Room to ask a question
editions.summary: The seven-agent farm with a usable mobile message field and device-keyboard voice guidance on its own row.

changes.title: Readable mobile dialogue controls
changes.description: Corrects the narrow message field caused by the voice-typing hint. The hint now wraps below the field, with 44-pixel input and send controls. Verified at 360, 390, 430 and 1280 pixels.

changes.title: Seven-agent experience retained
changes.description: Demand, Weather, Market, Production, Supply Chain, Profit and Planner keep distinct responsibilities. Community feeds remain explicitly unconnected. Earlier editions retain their saved state and images.
